topic: Claude Code isn't just for code: point it at a folder of notes
post:
Here's a secret about Claude Code: you don't need any code to use it. 🤫
You can point it at a folder of plain old notes.

Claude Code's own docs say it works in any folder, including a notes folder or a collection of documents. It can search, edit and reorganize them.

That makes it a super-powered search for your own files. 🔎

Try this with your meeting notes:

1️⃣ Put your notes in one folder (copy them first if you're nervous)
2️⃣ Open Claude Code in the Claude desktop app and point it at that folder
3️⃣ Ask in plain English

Copy this prompt:
"Read all the notes in this folder. List every action item assigned to me, with the date of the meeting it came from. Don't change any files."

That last sentence matters ✅
It keeps this a read-only job. Want extra safety? Turn on Plan mode from Day 10.

More ideas:
📌 "Which notes mention the budget?"
📌 "Summarize what we decided about hiring."

Good to know: Claude Code comes with Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans.

Why it matters:
Your notes are full of answers you've already written down. Claude Code helps you find them in seconds. 💡

What folder would you search first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
